enforced_by_construction.security.no_arbitrary_code: the spec is data-only (msgspec structs, no expr/code/url field); no arbitrary-code path exists to execute -> emitted as a constant-pass M1.5 affirmation, no bad-spec attack vector
enforced_by_construction.transform.ops_allowed: the transform tagged-union admits only {select,filter,group_by,aggregate,sort}; an unlisted op is unrepresentable at decode -> emitted as a constant-pass M1.5 affirmation, no bad-spec attack vector
enforced_by_construction.transform.aggregates_match_recomputation: renderer inlines only the recomputed data.values; no model-value path exists (M1.5/M1.6) -> no bad-spec attack vector
enforced_by_construction.transform.filters_declared: every filter is a declared transform.filter op; the verifier recomputes from declared transforms only -> an undeclared filter is unrepresentable
enforced_by_construction.derived_value_mismatch: DROPPED (roadmap data-flow): the model supplies no plotted values, so a derived-value lie is impossible by construction

formally_checked.sort.canonical_order: SMT checks the exact built row sequence against the active declared sort plus canonical tail before native Vega (M5.2)
formally_checked.scale.bar_zero: SMT checks every exact built quantitative bar channel carries scale.zero=true before native Vega (M5.2)
formally_checked.encoding.legend_domain_exact: SMT checks each exact built discrete color domain has complete, no-extra set equality with its plotted non-null categories before native Vega (M5.2)
